change_note: v0.6 was never a usable preregistration and must not be cited as frozen. v0.7 corrected its statistics but declared 36 sealed rules against its own cluster-power requirement of 117 to 208, so it was internally inconsistent on sizing and was never frozen either. v0.8 is written after an instrument review on 2026-08-11 that found four leakage paths, a scoring stage that discarded most issued evidence, and a generator whose seed varied surface text but not structure. It narrows the claim to what the current three-way answer space can support, fixes the instrument-acceptance method before any number is computed, and leaves all sizing empirical. See research/GENERATOR_REVISION_LOG.md and research/INSTRUMENT_ACCEPTANCE_PRECOMMIT.md.

claim_scope.rationale: The frozen answer stage selects among two opaque actions plus abstain and aggregates observed_action weighted by observed_outcome sign and recency. It infers from evidence rather than reading gold, but a three-way choice with chance near 0.5 bounds what any positive verdict can mean. A supported verdict licenses the statement that evidence-governed revisable concepts improve governed retrieval and application on structurally distant cases, not that they improve decisions in a fuller sense.

unit_of_analysis.rationale: Tasks generated from one latent rule share a gold action, an evidence set and a surface template, so they are not independent. Measured task-level design effects: 1.67x at 3 rules, 1.62x at 12, 1.11x at 32.
unit_of_analysis.sizing_note: Empirical. Determined from between-rule SD estimated on development after the scoring stage is frozen, via ell.statistics.clusters_for_power. No rule count is preregistered until then.

instrument_acceptance.note: A benchmark must be shown able to grade before it is used to grade. Criteria and their amendment history live in research/INSTRUMENT_ACCEPTANCE_PRECOMMIT.md. Method fixed 2026-08-11 while every technical participant was blind to post-repair eligible scores; numbers computed only after the final scorer lands.

band_method.estimand_of_x: Could a policy carrying no rule information have produced this score? The sampling distribution of that hypothesis is the permutation distribution, which is what makes option 1 correct. The paired comparator-minus-null SD belongs to a different null and is already carried by Y.
band_method.rejected_alternative: Comparator-minus-null paired SD. Rejected on estimand grounds, not on contamination grounds, so the ruling does not reopen if blindness is later lost.
band_method.gaussian_note: Measured at 2000 permutations the null tail is slightly lighter than Gaussian (q99.9 at mean+2.92sd against 3.09), so a normal approximation would be mildly conservative rather than wrong. Quantiles are used regardless because the distribution is discrete and bounded and quantiles cost nothing.
band_method.x_must_not_be: a multiple of the null standard deviation; the p95 already delivers alpha
band_method.pooling_prohibited: Floors and ceilings are not pooled or averaged across seeds. Worst-case across null policies within a seed.

measured_2026_08_11.provisional: Superseded when the final scorer lands. Recorded to show the corridor is not empty, against a target effect of 0.05.

instrument_acceptance.null_battery_reading: 1 breach in 120 tests, non-reproducible across seeds (1 of 8). Below the ~6 a p95 threshold produces by construction, which indicates the floor is slightly conservative. A conservative floor narrows the corridor and biases against ELL, which is the acceptable direction.

suspended_comparators.rolling-summary: Reclassified as a null policy. Recency selection was a covert rule oracle while records were laid out rule-block by rule-block. Re-admission requires passing the null battery at chance.

oracle_ceilings.oracle-retrieval: The only informative ceiling: exact gold evidence through the shared frozen answer stage.
oracle_ceilings.oracle-concept: Not a ceiling for any policy that must infer an action; it returned gold_action directly. Retired as a diagnostic.

invariants.information_boundary: Specified in terms of information about rule_id, not a field allowlist. None of the four leaks found on 2026-08-11 was an illegitimate field; each was a join between individually defensible fields. Inspection is insufficient, so the null battery runs continuously.

ceiling_namespace_binding.requirement: A test must bind the opaque shared action namespace to the ceiling.
ceiling_namespace_binding.rationale: The 0.8322 ceiling rests on observed_action x observed_outcome, the same field pair that carried the action-namespace leak. It is safe only while the namespace carries no rule-correlated semantics. Without a binding test a future namespace change could silently revalue the ceiling the bands are frozen against.

answer_stage.rationale: A 28-point ceiling swing on presentation order alone would make the primary estimand partly a measure of emission ordering rather than knowledge.

structural_sampling.rationale: Until 2026-08-11 the seed varied surface text only, so development and sealed were structurally the same dataset at different scale and anything tuned against development structure was tuned against sealed structure.

statistics.reproduction_requirement: Reproduction requires independent seeds that vary structure. Same-seed byte identity verifies determinism only and is not evidence of generalisation.
statistics.no_stop_claim_from_point_estimates: A stop or impossibility result must be sampling-robust, stated at the favourable end of the ceiling interval, with N recomputed in ell.statistics. A margin inside its own sampling error does not establish an empty interval.

power.method_only: All sizing is empirical and computed after the final scorer lands. The v0.7 discordance default of 0.25 was an unjustified placeholder and is not inherited.

transfer_strata.near: query reuses evidence vocabulary; lexical retrieval is viable
transfer_strata.far: zero content-word overlap with supporting evidence

benchmark.tiers_note: Empirical. Set after the final scorer from between-rule SD on development.

answer_space_expansion.hypothesis: A larger shared action space with a semantic bridge from record text to action permits a claim about decision quality rather than governed retrieval quality alone.
answer_space_expansion.grounding: To be specified from the LoCoMo-Plus and Mem2ActBench primary sources rather than invented, so the redesign is anchored to instruments others have validated.
answer_space_expansion.rationale: Recorded here so it is on the record rather than aspirational. Deferred because the current instrument has usable headroom and no measurement of any kind has yet been made; a narrow defensible result precedes a wider claim.
